thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P2 · Pager: @oncall-elaine · service=hosted-generate-v2 · symptom=canary error rate 6.3% (>5% threshold) · link=https://go/ops/incidents/6187

oncall-elaine: On it, looking at canary dashboards and traces.

eng-lead-raj: Noticed a model_v2 variant rollout earlier at ~20:50 UTC — routing 10% to canary. Was this scheduled?

sre-max: Rolling rollback policy didn't auto-trigger. Logs show repeated 502s from model-worker-3 and OOMs around 20:58.

ops-kai: Flag `model_v2_rollout` is at 10%. Can flip to 0% to throttle the canary traffic. @oncall-elaine want me to flip now?

oncall-elaine: Yes. Flip to 0% and pause the auto-rollout. Also open a manual rollback window and mark mitigation in incident ticket. Tagging @eng-lead-raj to verify.

eng-lead-raj: Confirmed. Flipping flag. Collecting quick sample traces: `curl -sS "https://canary-host.internal/logs?tail=50" | sed -n '1,80p'`

incident-bot: Action requested: feature flag flip by oncall-elaine — awaiting ops-kai confirmation...

ops-kai: flipped `model_v2_rollout -> 0` :white_check_mark: Initiating drain of canary instances, notifying infra.

sre-max: Drain job queued — issuing traffic-siphon command to move remaining requests to stable pool: `./scripts/traffic-shift --service hosted-generate-v2 --from canary --to stable --percent 100 --timeout 120s`

eng-lead-raj: Error rate dropping — canary error rate down from 6.3% to 0.9% over last 2 minutes. Looks like drain is doing its job.

product-amy: Support saw a spike in failures for the "Compose" flow — roughly 20 customers reported errors during the window. No major accounts impacted based on initial quick check.

oncall-elaine: Good. Notify support with a short blurb, advise customers it was transient and mitigation applied. We'll run verification tests and keep the flag at 0% until root cause is identified.

eng-lead-raj: Running a quick smoke test: `go run ./tools/smoke --endpoint us-west-2 --model stable` -> OK, responses within SLO.

sre-max: Tentative root cause: memory layout regression from recent kernel image + model V2 weight layout. Repro on staging in progress. Opening RCA ticket and will pin kernel for next deploy if confirmed.

ops-kai: Scheduling a manual canary re-roll only after a fix. For now flag remains 0% and we will monitor for 30m.

oncall-elaine: I'll keep watch and page if it regresses. Filing incident doc: https://go/ops/INC-6187 with timeline and runbook steps.

incident-bot: Incident state update: mitigation in place — manual rollback/feature-flag throttle completed. Severity downgraded to P3.

customer-jordan: Appreciate the quick response. Our users saw short failures but service is back to normal. Thanks team.
